_note: Nox's nightmare journal doodles, from the journal tables. How many by age, then 1d20 each (no repeats on a page). Results 17-20 are his future tattoos. Knives only from age 15. Sarethai runes appear in the margins of the earliest notebooks only, before he was six, and never again. Each entry's prompt is what the image generator is asked to draw.
runes: a few small, angular, made-up symbols in a column down one side, like a secret code only he knows
